item.title: PyTorch Announces Alpamayo 2 Super Under Linux Foundation's OpenMDW-1.1 License
item.summary: PyTorch announced that NVIDIA's Alpamayo 2 Super autonomous vehicle reasoning model is available on Hugging Face under OpenMDW-1.1, the Linux Foundation's permissive license that explicitly permits fine-tuning, derivative models, and commercial redistribution for AV developers and automakers.
